subject: Request: SCIM reconciliation samples + RBAC least-privilege evidence (SOC 2 / SIG)
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@greenleaf.health>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SCIM + RBAC evidence request for SOC 2 / SIG intake

Hi Sean,

Hope you’re well — we’re working through our SOC 2 evidence collection and our third-party assessor asked for a short set of artifacts related to provisioning and authorization for Redwood’s hosted offering. Could you please provide the following by EoD PT on Friday?

- A sample SCIM delta export for March 2027 (CSV or JSON) showing adds/updates/deletes with timestamps and responsible actor if available.
- A snapshot of the RBAC role->permission mapping for tenant-level roles, and an owner / approver for each role.
- Any documentation or runbook describing how SCIM reconciliation and role assignments are handled in production (high level is fine).

If there are any PII concerns, we can accept redacted samples. We’ll use these for the assessor’s traceability tests (SIG and SOC 2 control ORG-1 / IAM-3).

Thanks,
Lydia
AuditOps — GreenLeaf Health

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@greenleaf.health>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCIM + RBAC evidence request for SOC 2 / SIG intake

Lydia — thanks for the clear list. We’ll pull a redacted SCIM delta and the RBAC snapshot and get them to you. Quick notes:

- I’ve looped in Jon as our security lead and Marissa for the account coordination.
- We’ll aim to deliver the sample SCIM CSV and the role snapshot by Friday EoD PT. If engineering needs more time to scrub e-mails or UIDs, we’ll let you know by tomorrow.

Action items:
1) Jonas: confirm what level of user-identifiers we can include and any redaction guidance.
2) Marcus (cc’d on follow-up): create the SCIM delta export and RBAC snapshot; flag any sensitive fields.

Marissa — can you confirm the HubSpot deal id for this engagement so I can attach the artifacts there?

Thanks,
Sean
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Cc: lydia.park@greenleaf.health
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCIM + RBAC evidence request for SOC 2 / SIG intake

Team — brief policy guidance:

- We should provide the SCIM delta with hashed user IDs (sha256) and omit email addresses when feasible. Include timestamps (UTC) and the SCIM operation type (create/update/patch/delete).
- The RBAC snapshot should map role_id -> permissions (short labels) and include an "owner" field that references an internal role or team (not a PII-bearing username).
- Attach the runbook excerpt that explains reconciliation frequency, conflict resolution, and who can approve role changes.

I’ll review the artifacts before delivery. Marcus — please drop the exports into the secure Drive link and paste the link in-thread when ready.

Jonas Weber
Sr. Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.example.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCIM + RBAC evidence request for SOC 2 / SIG intake

Folks — attached are the redacted artifacts:

- Attachment: scim_delta_202703.csv (CSV) — exported from the provisioning service for 2027-03-01 -> 2027-03-31. PII columns redacted; user_id column hashed with sha256; operation and timestamp preserved.
- Attachment: rbac_role_map_snapshot_20270401.json (JSON) — compact mapping of internal role_id to permission labels + owner_team fields.
- Attachment: access_owner_manifest_202703.pdf (PDF) — short manifest listing approval owners and last review date for each tenant-level role.

Notes on generation:
- SCIM export includes actor_type where available (system/service/user). We removed raw email addresses and replaced them with hashed values.
- Role mapping intentionally omits system-level service accounts; those are covered in separate artifact (can share if the assessor wants).
- I scrubbed account numbers and any freeform notes containing customer names.

Links: https://drive.redwood.com/GreenLeaf/SCIM-deltas/2027-03 (secure link, access limited to recipients)

If you want a CSV with clearer column headers or a small sample with unhashed IDs under an NDA, let me know and we’ll coordinate with Legal.

—Marcus
Platform Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs included in thread: scim_delta_202703.csv (csv), rbac_role_map_snapshot_20270401.json (json), access_owner_manifest_202703.pdf (pdf)]

From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@greenleaf.health>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCIM + RBAC evidence request for SOC 2 / SIG intake

Sean/Team — received, thank you. The artifacts look good for the assessor’s initial review. A couple of follow-ups from AuditOps:

- Can you confirm the reconciliation cadence and whether there’s an automated nightly job or a manual process? (a one-line confirmation is fine).
- For the RBAC snapshot, the assessor asks for proof that role owners approved the last changes (timestamped sign-off). If you have a short audit trail or JIRA ticket ids, please add those.

If you can drop the confirmation and any ticket ids into the Drive folder, we’ll mark this as "ready" in our tracker. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Lydia
AuditOps — GreenLeaf Health
